primary_family.description: all confirmatory PC-NFPSO versus baseline tests across synthetic and real domains

primary_sign_test.all_ties_rule: if wins+losses==0 set raw p-value to 1.0

primary_estimand_ci.point_estimate: sample median of all finite paired differences
primary_estimand_ci.method: exact nonparametric order-statistic interval by binomial inversion
primary_estimand_ci.construction: sort n finite paired differences; choose largest integer k>=1 satisfying 2*BinomCDF(k-1;n,0.5)<=0.05; CI=[D_(k),D_(n-k+1)]
primary_estimand_ci.note: CI and primary effect target the same median location estimand

primary_directional_claim.otherwise: no statistically supported directional superiority claim
primary_directional_claim.language: statistical non-significance is not interpreted as equivalence

synthetic_dependence.raw_condition: process x DGP seed x noise level
synthetic_dependence.noise_aggregation: arithmetic mean across confirmatory noise levels 0.05,0.10,0.20

support_rules.common_success_pairs: pairwise accuracy test uses finite observed forecasts from both models and reports n explicitly
support_rules.failed_or_nonestimable_comparator_in_pri: retain hypothesis with p=1.0 rather than shrink the Holm family
support_rules.failure_rates: reported separately for every method and domain

holm_algorithm.adjustment: for ordered p_(i), q_(i)=max over j<=i of min(1,(m-j+1)*p_(j)); map q back to original hypotheses

sensitivity_wilcoxon.multiplicity: report raw and Holm-adjusted values using the same 18 comparison labels, separately identified as sensitivity results
sensitivity_wilcoxon.interpretation_note: signed-rank inference is not treated as interchangeable with the primary median/sign-test estimand

secondary_mean_effect.synthetic_resampling: stratified bootstrap: resample DGP-seed analysis units with replacement within each process and preserve process sizes
secondary_mean_effect.real_resampling: stratified bootstrap: resample final real series with replacement within each source-frequency stratum and preserve stratum sizes

prohibitions: no treating optimizer replicates as independent units
no treating noise variants as independent units
no replacing failed forecasts with another model
no changing multiplicity family after inspecting p-values
